defects.summary: Both mobile text captures visibly contain an unwanted internal scrollbar-like mark beside the numbered solid-angle equation.

location.coordinateSystem: Screenshot pixels; top-left origin; approximate bounds of the artifact, not a new crop.

defects.actual: A narrow rounded gray vertical bar stands immediately to the right of the stacked fraction, between it and (6.1). It is inside the formula line, distinct from the page scrollbar at the far right, and disrupts clean mathematical typography.
defects.expected: The short equation and its number display cleanly without an internal scrollbar or scrollbar-like artifact.
defects.scope: DISPLAY only. The mathematical expression remains recognizable. No source, scientific, textual or figure-fidelity failure is asserted; implementation cause and desktop equation appearance were not rechecked.
defects.repairDisposition: Ordinary reversible repair is authorized by the latest user instruction but was not performed by this reviewer. Preserve approved mathematical content and fig134 assets; correct the display artifact, then review only affected changed evidence within the caller's authorization.
